Task complete. Summary:

- Wrote `out/T2/plan.yaml`: for each of the 16 layers, `concat`s the two row-slices (`[0:640,:]` + `[768:2048,:]`) of q/k/v_proj and the two column-slices (`[:,0:640]` + `[:,768:2048]`) of o_proj into `<name>__pruned` tensors, then a single regex `delete` removes all 64 original full-width tensors and a single regex `move` (with `\1`/`\2` captures) renames all 64 pruned tensors back onto their original names. Preflight and required-check `assert`s cover shapes and the 114-tensor count.
- Ran it once with `.venv/bin/brainsurgery out/T2/plan.yaml`; it succeeded on the first attempt.
- Verified independently: output has exactly 114 tensors, layer-0 shapes match the spec (`[1920,2048]` for q/k/v, `[2048,1920]` for o_proj), and spot-checked layer 7's q_proj/o_proj values against a manual `torch.cat` of the original slices — bit-exact match; an untouched MLP tensor also matches the original exactly.
- Wrote `out/T2/REPORT.md` with the self-report.
